- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2747-2816 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: dispatch_and_register_poller accepts the first sole workflow_dispatch candidate with id > baseline_id without correlating it to the dispatch issued by this invocation.
  WHY: A concurrent manual or workflow-dispatch run can be indexed first, causing Phase 6 to pin and report the wrong run; severity was BLOCKER in minimax, qwen, and MAJOR in deepseek, kimi, and grok.

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2775-2778 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: A failed post-dispatch workflow-run listing immediately returns 2 instead of retrying within the 90-second registration window.
  WHY: One transient GitHub Actions API error aborts the e2e-smoke-test job despite the surrounding loop being designed to absorb indexing delays.

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2875-2891 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: A single pinned-run read failure or malformed payload writes status=poller_failed, closes the tracking issue, and exits 0 instead of continuing within the inactivity window.
  WHY: The verify step treats poller_failed as non-blocking, so one transient API or malformed-response event can make the release pass without exercising the review-blocked recovery path.

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:469-487 vs lines 1409-1410 and lines 391-414 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The conservative serial budget models the review phase as max(REVIEW_TIMEOUT, REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT), although neither setting bounds total review wall-clock time.
  WHY: A healthy review phase can exceed the modeled 75-minute term and consume the finalization reserve, potentially reaching the 300-minute job timeout despite the budget guard passing.

- .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt:changelog.d block around 172; tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_* block at 863-865 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The generated workspace manifest adds unrelated paths but omits changelog.d/4163-e2e-review-blocked-budget.md and tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py.
  WHY: The incomplete inventory does not match the branch and excludes the new files from workspace materialization and deterministic manifest union-merge handling; grok rated this NIT while the other reviewers rated it MAJOR.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: The function accepts any sole candidate with id > baseline_id without per-dispatch correlation, and tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py has no coverage rejecting a concurrent-dispatch race.

- requirement: "Add a focused contract test covering the timeout-budget invariant and exact-run selection" with acceptance criterion "Focused tests and workflow syntax validation pass."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, alongside the three sibling Test-and-mark-stable contract-test steps at ci.yml:827-845
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py is registered only in test-and-mark-stable.yml:3798; ci.yml has no reference to it, although the sibling contract tests are registered there.

- requirement: "Regenerate the workspace manifest from this branch or remove the unrelated manifest edit rather than shipping an incomplete inventory."
  expected_change_site: .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The manifest omits changelog.d/4163-e2e-review-blocked-budget.md and tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py, despite adding unrelated manifest entries.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
